name: A Noble Brew
summary: Zardeth of the Black Claw sends you to the Royal Keep with Black Claw Stout for Lord Baurles K. Wishock. The brew must reach him in the Hall of Petitioners.

sections.title: A Noble Hypocrite
sections.body: In Stormwind Keep, Lord Baurles K. Wishock speaks of his importance and the kingdom’s future. Yet patrons of the Slaughtered Lamb know he drinks in the tavern’s upper rooms at night and leaves large bills unpaid. By day, he petitions to have the tavern shut down.

sections.title: A Lethal Toast
sections.body: Beneath the Slaughtered Lamb, Zardeth of the Black Claw brews Black Claw Stout to settle Wishock’s debt for good. Zardeth says the drink carries quite a kick. Wishock mistakes you for a servant and tosses you a copper coin. He drinks greedily, then collapses dead in the halls of the keep.

faq.q: Who is Zardeth of the Black Claw?
faq.answer: Zardeth of the Black Claw is a warlock with a hidden cabal in catacombs beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter. He carries out dangerous, secret operations beyond the city guard’s sight.

faq.q: Why does Zardeth target Lord Wishock?
faq.answer: Wishock drinks in the upper floors of the Slaughtered Lamb at night without paying his bills. By day, he goes to the Hall of Petitioners and asks the authorities to close the tavern.
Lord Baurles K. Wishock is found in the Hall of Petitioners, an antechamber in Stormwind Keep where nobles and citizens gather to lobby the realm’s regency.

faq.q: How does Lord Wishock receive the brew?
faq.answer: Wishock mistakes you for a servant, takes the stout as a refreshing drink and dismisses you with a copper coin.

faq.q: Does delivering the stout attract the guards' attention?
faq.answer: The delivery appears to be an ordinary servant bringing a drink, and you can go on without a confrontation with the guards.
The delivery is followed by 'You Have Served Us Well,' which sends you back to Zardeth beneath the Slaughtered Lamb.
